name: mstack-receive-review
description: Process any code review as claims to check: verify each finding against the code with the method its type calls for, fix what holds with a failing test first and in every place with the same mistake, reject what does not with evidence, and log every outcome with a drafted reply, without asking the user. The other mstack skills call it for every review. One skill for Claude Code and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Verify, fix or reject every review finding, with evidence.
interface.longDescription: Processes reviews from a cross-vendor reviewer, the advisor, CI bots or pull-request comments: labels and merges findings, verifies each against the code, fixes what holds test-first, rejects what does not with an artifact, respects the user's recorded decisions, and logs every outcome with a drafted reply. Nothing is posted.
